sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The outcome constraints are unconditional: sh:minCount 1 and sh:hasValue true on both protection-status properties require every targeted ship to have both statuses, even when the applicability conditions are false. Move their existence and exact-true enforcement into the conditional applicability check, so only a ship satisfying Category A/B, shipType = "oil_tanker", rdf:type nltl:oilTanker, deadweight < 5000 metric tonnes, and constructionDate >= 2017-01-01 is required to have both statuses exactly true.
